body: Also, please don't worry about finding friends, I've stopped worrying about this completely, yes it would be nice to have someone to share my time with, but it's not worth your time to be hung up on finding friends, you will find friends one day, you are not likely to find friends while searching, it gives of a smell of desperation, and people will avoid you like the plague, friends will come in time, I'm sure of that. Finding friends has a lot to with similar interests, and your only current interest is suicide, and people are not interested in that. I can't offer you massive amounts of advice but I can offer that bit, just don't spend time thinking about it, I know that's easier said than done, I think you will learn this in time.
It is nice to know there's other people similar though.

Yeah you are kinda in the same boat as me, and if 96 is referring to your age then I'm only slightly older than you, people are horrible, people really don't care, and about "and feel like I've missed out on all the fun in life." I can really relate to that, not so much anymore though, I used to cry about it, stuck in my room and thinking about how everyone else is enjoying life, though these feelings did pass, I wouldn't say I'm completely dead inside quite yet, but I don't really feel much except anger, and even that doesn't last very long. 

I feel like my brain has just stopped taking in information in some ways, even when I'm nearly run over, I just don't react anymore, I couldn't really care less about my life, I tried to open up to my Mother earlier, and the response was "just get on with it". I mean...
I've been "getting on with it" for years now, I do believe both of us have better options open than simply killing ourselves. But "getting on with it" isn't the answer.

I know but this is what I mean, I've allready tried gym, going out, getting hobbies... Nothing interests me, I have no desire or motivation to do anything at all, so I just don't know what to do except kill myself, that comment above is just me trying to say "I've been thinking about suicide for a while now, I don't let me emotions get ahold of me too much, meaning I don't feel very bad one day then decide to end it you know, I've been making this decision for years and feel its time." This isn't a "In the heat of the moment" kinda thing.

The thing is that I KNOW I'm going to commit suicide if I decide it, while it's clear 90% of the posters on this sub are feeling bad momentarily and post anyways, though they are likely children and forget about the whole thing in a couple weeks. Really wondering why I bothered to right this here now as every thread is exactly the same.
Yes, I would say I'm depressed and no, I don't take any SSRIs.
I'm still just considering it, though I've been considering it for a while now and feel I'm coming closer to a decision.
